user_story: As a staff member, I want deleting a confirmed booking to return an error so that active reservations are protected.

positive.title: Successfully handles attempted deletion of an active reservation
steps: Log in as a staff member
Locate a confirmed booking that is active
Attempt to delete the confirmed booking
positive.expected_result: An error message is displayed stating that active reservations cannot be deleted.

negative.title: Attempting to delete an inactive booking
steps: Log in as a staff member
Locate a confirmed booking that is inactive
Attempt to delete the confirmed booking
negative.expected_result: The booking is deleted successfully without any error.

edge.title: Delete operation on a confirmed booking with special characters in its ID
steps: Log in as a staff member
Locate a confirmed booking with special characters in its ID
Attempt to delete the confirmed booking
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed stating that active reservations cannot be deleted.
